mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This units next attack is empowered.
This unit has increased Move Speed.
You are seen by the pack!

mLocKeys.keySummary: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Naafiri surges forward, dealing @TotalDamageFirstSlash@ physical damage, then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing @TotalDamageSecondSlash@ physical damage.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Naafiri creates a Packmate every @PackmateSpawnCooldown@ seconds that will Attack enemies that she targets for @PackmateTotalDamage@ physical damage, increased to @FrenzyDamageTooltipOnly@ after she uses an Ability.

Hitting champions and large monsters with Abilities reduces this Ability's Cooldown by @CooldownReduceOnAbilityHit@ seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by @CooldownReduceOnKill@ seconds.

Max Packmates: @PackmateCap@
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_NaafiriP_Tooltip}}

Packmates deal @PackmateMonsterMod*100@% damage to Monsters and @PackmateTowerModifier*100@% damage to structures.
Packmates take @AOEDamageModifier@ damage from AOE Abilities and effects.
Packmates take @NonChampDamageModifier*100@% damage from non-epic monsters and minions.
Packmates take @MeleeAttackDamageModifier*100@% damage from melee champion Attacks.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.

Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalDamageFirstCast@ physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalBleedDamage@ physical damage over @spell.NaafiriQ:BleedDuration@ seconds.

Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMinDamageSecondCast@ and @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMaxDamageSecondCast@ physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalHealSecondCast@ Health.

Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for @spell.NaafiriP:PackmateTauntDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Executes lane minions and non-epic monsters below @MinionExecuteThreshold@ health.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Naafiri can recast Darkin Dagger at no cost.

Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalDamageFirstCast@ physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalBleedDamage@ physical damage over @spell.NaafiriQ:BleedDuration@ seconds.

Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMinDamageSecondCast@ and @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMaxDamageSecondCast@ physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalHealSecondCast@ Health.

Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for @spell.NaafiriP:PackmateTauntDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Naafiri becomes Untargetable for @UntargetableDuration@ second and prepares to hunt, spawning @PackmatesToAdd@ additional Packmates and gaining @BonusAD@ Attack Damage and @MoveSpeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @Duration@ seconds.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing @PackmateDamage@ physical damage per Packmate.

If Naafiri scores a Takedown within @TakedownWindow@ seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants @ShieldTotal@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Briefly extends<keywordMajor> The Call of the Pack</keywordMajor>.</rules>
